plotters: canonical _plot_rank_heatmap + _plot_cluster_boundaries (heatmap); _hist_aligned + _cluster_aligned (canonical-styled, on heatmap 1-unit coord so the 3 left panels share an aligned channel y-axis via sharey)
event_filter: sign is not None and n_part >= 2*k_dir (4)

similarity_matrix_panel.model_templates_built_by: event sign (forward = sign>0 events, reverse = sign<0 events), NOT cluster label
similarity_matrix_panel.perm_p_direction: diagonal one-sided positive, off-diagonal one-sided negative (swap-predicted)
similarity_matrix_panel.stars: panel shows directional channel-shuffle permutation p as stars only; color = Spearman ρ

notes: Rank heatmap + rank distribution + cluster profiles drawn by the MATURE canonical functions (same as the per_subject propagation figure), not hand-rolled.
Model fwd/rev templates built by EVENT SIGN (not cluster label); similarity matrix GATED on >= MIN_DIR_EVENTS of each direction (one-direction subjects -> N/A, not a fake swap).
Full/active imputed inter-cluster corr is not the main direction readout; shared-overlap corr + direction purity are the cleaner direction judges.
If both KMeans clusters have the same direction, display labels are same-template subclusters (e.g. t_b-1/t_b-2), not a fake t_a/t_b pair.
